PushBoxGame.__init__:
[DEFINE_WORKER: "Initializes a new game state by storing the supplied map reference, setting the player position to (0, 0), creating independent empty lists for targets and boxes, setting target count to zero, marking the game as not over, and then calling self.init_game()." __init__]
    [INPUTS]
        <REF> map </REF>: object "The game map object supplied by the caller; stored by reference in self.map without copying."
    [END_INPUTS]

    [OUTPUTS]
    [END_OUTPUTS]

    [MAIN_FLOW]
        [SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
            [COMMAND Store the caller-supplied map parameter into the instance attribute self.map by reference, not as a copy. RESULT self.map]
            [COMMAND Set the player's starting row to the literal constant 0, representing the top row boundary. RESULT self.player_row]
            [COMMAND Set the player's starting column to the literal constant 0, representing the leftmost column boundary. RESULT self.player_col]
            [COMMAND Initialize self.targets to a new empty list, independent from self.boxes. RESULT self.targets]
            [COMMAND Initialize self.boxes to a new empty list, independent from self.targets. RESULT self.boxes]
            [COMMAND Set self.target_count to the literal constant 0, consistent with the empty targets list. RESULT self.target_count]
            [COMMAND Set self.is_game_over to the literal constant False, marking the initial game state as not over. RESULT self.is_game_over]
            [COMMAND Call self.init_game() after all initial attribute assignments are complete to perform additional initialization and potentially update the current state. RESULT init_game_result]
        [END_SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
    [END_MAIN_FLOW]

[END_WORKER]
PushBoxGame.init_game:
[DEFINE_WORKER: "Initialize the game state by scanning the map grid to locate the player start, target positions, and box positions." init_game]
    [INPUTS]
    [END_INPUTS]

    [OUTPUTS]
    [END_OUTPUTS]

    [MAIN_FLOW]
        [SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
            [COMMAND For each row in range(len(self.map)): RESULT row]
            [COMMAND Within the outer for loop over row, for each col in range(len(self.map[row])): RESULT col]
            [COMMAND Within the outer for loop over row and inner for loop over col, if self.map[row][col] equals "O", assign row to self.player_row and col to self.player_col. RESULT self.player_row]
            [COMMAND Within the outer for loop over row and inner for loop over col, else if self.map[row][col] equals "G", append (row, col) to self.targets and increment self.target_count by 1. RESULT self.targets]
            [COMMAND Within the outer for loop over row and inner for loop over col, else if self.map[row][col] equals "X", append (row, col) to self.boxes. RESULT self.boxes]
        [END_SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
    [END_MAIN_FLOW]

[END_WORKER]
PushBoxGame.check_win:
[DEFINE_WORKER: "Count how many boxes are on targets and mark the game as over when the number of boxes on targets equals the target count." check_win]
    [INPUTS]
    [END_INPUTS]

    [OUTPUTS]
        <REF> is_game_over </REF>: boolean "Indicates whether the game has been marked as over after checking whether all targets are covered by boxes."
    [END_OUTPUTS]

    [MAIN_FLOW]
        [SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
            [COMMAND Initialize box_on_target_count to the integer constant 0. RESULT box_on_target_count]
            [COMMAND For each box in self.boxes: if box is in self.targets, increment box_on_target_count by 1; otherwise do nothing and continue to the next box. RESULT box_on_target_count]
            [COMMAND After the loop, if box_on_target_count equals self.target_count, set self.is_game_over to True; if the condition is false, leave self.is_game_over unchanged. RESULT is_game_over]
            [COMMAND Return self.is_game_over. RESULT is_game_over]
        [END_SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
    [END_MAIN_FLOW]

[END_WORKER]
PushBoxGame.move:
[DEFINE_WORKER: "Attempts to move the player in the given direction, pushing a box when the target cell contains one and the box destination is not a wall, and returns the result of check_win." move]
    [INPUTS]
        <REF> direction </REF>: str "One-character movement direction: 'w' up, 's' down, 'a' left, 'd' right; any other value leaves the proposed coordinates unchanged."
    [END_INPUTS]

    [OUTPUTS]
        <REF> result </REF>: bool "The return value from self.check_win() after the attempted move."
    [END_OUTPUTS]

    [MAIN_FLOW]
        [SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
            [COMMAND Initialize new_player_row from self.player_row and new_player_col from self.player_col. RESULT new_player_coords]
            [COMMAND Determine the proposed player coordinates by checking direction: if direction equals 'w', decrement new_player_row by 1; else if direction equals 's', increment new_player_row by 1; else if direction equals 'a', decrement new_player_col by 1; else if direction equals 'd', increment new_player_col by 1; otherwise leave both new_player_row and new_player_col unchanged. RESULT proposed_player_coords]
            [COMMAND If self.map[new_player_row][new_player_col] is '#', skip the player and box update logic; otherwise enter the target-cell-clear branch. RESULT wall_check]
            [COMMAND Within the target-cell-clear branch, if (new_player_row, new_player_col) is present in self.boxes, compute new_box_row = new_player_row + (new_player_row - self.player_row) and new_box_col = new_player_col + (new_player_col - self.player_col); otherwise enter the empty-cell branch. RESULT box_check]
            [COMMAND Within the target-cell-clear branch and box-present branch, if self.map[new_box_row][new_box_col] is '#', skip the box push and player update; otherwise remove (new_player_row, new_player_col) from self.boxes, append (new_box_row, new_box_col) to self.boxes, set self.player_row = new_player_row, and set self.player_col = new_player_col. RESULT box_push_attempt]
            [COMMAND Within the target-cell-clear branch and empty-cell branch, set self.player_row = new_player_row and self.player_col = new_player_col. RESULT player_move]
            [COMMAND Return self.check_win(). RESULT move_result]
        [END_SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
    [END_MAIN_FLOW]

[END_WORKER]
